numerical_failure.observed_behavior: The resid property of the UECM model obtained via UECM.from_ardl subtracts the fitted values of the UECM (in differences) from the endogenous variable of the ARDL (in levels), so the residuals are computed incorrectly and flow into residual diagnostic tests such as serial correlation tests.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The UECM should have the same residuals as the equivalent ARDL model, since no transformation is made to the residuals when deriving the UECM from the ARDL.
trigger_conditions: Creating a UECM model from an ARDL model using statsmodels.tsa.ardl.UECM.from_ardl
Fitting the UECM and accessing its resid property

input_output_examples.input: ardl = sm.tsa.ARDL(S[:,[0]], 1, S[:,[1]], 1); ardlfit = ardl.fit(); uecm = sm.tsa.UECM.from_ardl(ardl); uecmfit = uecm.fit(); uecmfit.resid
input_output_examples.buggy_output: residuals computed by subtracting UECM fitted values (differences) from ARDL endogenous values (levels)
input_output_examples.expected_output: ardlfit.resid (the same residuals as the equivalent ARDL model)

oracle_clues: Check that UECM endog equals ARDL endog in levels: S[:,0].squeeze() == uecmfit.model.endog.squeeze()
Fix overrides the resid property of UECM to compute correct residuals
PR required adding a test that fails on main and passes with the fix

category_specific_evidence: Issue #9323 states that UECM.from_ardl residuals subtract UECM fitted values (in differences) from the ARDL endogenous value (in levels), so the residuals are incorrect.
Issue #9323 states the UECM should have the same residuals as the equivalent ARDL, since no transformation is made to the residuals when deriving the UECM from the ARDL.
The fix adds a resid property to UECM results that returns model._y - self.fittedvalues, replacing the incorrect residual computation.
The issue reproduction compares uecmfit.resid (observed) against ardlfit.resid (expected) and checks that S[:,0] equals uecmfit.model.endog.
The PR body states a regression test should reproduce the bug on main and pass with the fix, but no specific test values are given in the passages.
reproduction_risks: The passages do not give expected numeric residual values, so the expected output must be derived by comparing UECM residuals to ARDL residuals rather than from a fixed number.
The issue sample uses random simulation (np.random.multivariate_normal) without a seed, so exact values are not reproducible unless a seed is fixed.
The issue code sample is truncated in the passage, so the full reproduction script is not available.
The model._y attribute is used in the fix; a reproduction should confirm the level-valued endog is used rather than differenced values.
